name: semantic_recall
description: Semantic search using AI embeddings - finds memories by MEANING, not just keywords. ALWAYS use this for natural language questions like 'What food do I love?', 'When do I celebrate?', 'What's my favorite color?'. This understands concepts: 'spouse born' finds 'wife_birthday', 'what food' finds 'favorite_food'. More powerful but slower than keyword search.

query.description: Natural language search query - can be a question or topic

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return
